yes only if explicit: preprocessing/normalisation/feature selection/tuning fitted on training data only, or explicit non-overlap of windows across splits. NA if no model.

Quantitative evaluation metrics reported.
Page/section supporting the validation, subject-independence and leakage codes (also for "no").

definition and decision rule: Concurrent = label describes the same window/level/session as the input. Continuous = time-resolved trace y(t). Forecast = predicts affect at t+h from inputs ending at t, h>0. NA if no model.
yes only if the model outputs a time-resolved affect trace (or continuous-valued affect over time) and it is evaluated.

yes only if ALL: affect target, explicit positive horizon, target window not overlapping the input, quantitative held-out evaluation. Engagement-only, churn, errors or raw physiology targets do not count.

definition and decision rule: For trained models: could this design have been evaluated as a forecast? "could be" = labels refer to a later period than some inputs, but the authors did not frame/evaluate it as a forecast.
Stated horizon or input-target offset, if any.
Page/section supporting the temporal codes.
